subject: Recap + next step: dedicated capacity sizing deep dive for Nimbus Retail
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samira Qureshi <samira.qureshi@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next step: dedicated capacity sizing deep dive for Nimbus Retail

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap to make sure we’re aligned and to propose the next step: a focused "Dedicated Capacity Sizing" session where we walk through throughput, latency SLOs, traffic shape, and a concrete GPU pool recommendation.

Call recap (high level):
- Primary use case: in-store receipt parsing + short-form product Q&A (real-time kiosk responses).
- Peak burst: weekend evenings for ~30–45 minutes; sustained weekday baseline.
- Sensitive data: PII in receipts — customer requires retention policy & KMS audit logs.

What we want to cover in the sizing session:
1) Expected concurrent requests and burst QPS (requests/sec) and typical tokens per request.
2) Latency targets: p95 <= 300ms for kiosk path (goal), p95 <= 800ms for async batch scoring.
3) Throughput vs cost trade-offs: model family (LlamaX-13B / quantized variant) and batching/kv-cache expectations.
4) Network/regional constraints and private deployment options (VPC).

Proposed 60-minute slots next week (all in PDT):
- Tue Aug 3, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Aug 4, 14:00–15:00
- Thu Aug 5, 08:30–09:30

Could you confirm which slot works best, or propose alternatives? If useful, include Tom Hale (engineering lead) on the sizing call — he'll have the infra numbers.

Prep request (small):
- If you can, fill the attached intake sheet (nimbus_intake_template.xlsx) with sample QPS, tokens/request distribution, and a short list of peak windows.
- If you already have a short traffic export, attach it (nimbus_traffic_sample.csv is fine).

Attachments: nimbus_intake_template.xlsx, nimbus_service_diagram.png

I’ll loop in Marissa to lock the calendar and pre-seed an agenda (load profile + test plan).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

—Rafael
Rafael Mendes | Account Exec, Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Samira Qureshi <samira.qureshi@nimbusretail.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Tom Hale <tom.hale@nimbusretail.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 09:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next step: dedicated capacity sizing deep dive for Nimbus Retail

Thanks Rafael — great summary. Tom and I had a quick sync after the call; we can make the Wed Aug 4, 14:00–15:00 slot work. Please include Tom — he’ll cover infra and expected concurrency numbers.

Preliminary numbers (high level):
- Baseline QPS: ~12 requests/sec globally (weekday daytime).
- Peak bursts: 180–220 requests/sec for 30–45 minutes (weekend promos).
- Avg tokens/request: 120 (kiosk receipts + short completion), 400 tokens for batch scoring.
- Target p95 latency: <= 350ms for kiosk path, < 1s for batch.

I’ve attached a small traffic sample (nimbus_traffic_sample.csv) with per-hour counts for the last 2 weeks and a very rough annotation of promo windows. Also attached a short diagram of our edge routing (nimbus_service_diagram.png).

On security/retention: we need KMS integration and a 30-day retention window for logs, with the option to extend. We’ll share the SOC2 questionnaire next week during procurement.

If you need anything else before Wed, ping me.

—Samira

Great — Wed Aug 4, 14:00–15:00 PDT is confirmed. I just sent a Google Calendar invite titled "Nimbus — Dedicated Capacity Sizing (Redwood)" with dial-in and a working agenda.

Agenda (pre-seeded):
- 0–10m: quick intros and scope confirmation
- 10–30m: traffic profile walkthrough (Samira/Tom)
- 30–50m: Redwood runbook: model variants, batching, pooling, and expected GPU footprint
- 50–60m: next steps: test plan, pilot timeline, procurement touchpoints

Prep items (linked in the invite):
- Intake sheet (filled by Nimbus): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bNx-nimbus-sizing

Rafael — I’ll bring the sizing worksheet and propose an initial GPU pool recommendation based on the CSV Samira attached.

Thanks all — see you Wed.

—Marissa
